==Description==
'''Fish Spin''' is an emote that could be obtained at level 9 of the regular [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] track. It was made by Capra. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. The player is unable to move while performing the emote or interact with it.

This emote gives the player two fish which their avatar will hold in its hands and begin constantly spinning it while dancing.

It has a cost of {{BeachBalls|240}} or {{Robux|38}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{BeachBalls|1,150}} or {{Robux|396}}. Prior to the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] individual skip cost fix, it had a total cost of {{Robux|460}}. This item also has had two other costs. First one was the cost before its 20% discount, which had a cost of {{Robux|48}} with a total cost of {{Robux|500}}. The second was the price prior to the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] individual skip cost fix, where it had with a total cost of {{Robux|460}}.

==Trivia==
*This emote is a reference to the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/leekspin-loituma-girl leekspin] meme, a meme where a female anime character or in later edits any other character, like [[wp:Hatsune_Miku|Hatsune Miku]], is spinning a leek.
**The song that plays during the emote is a remix of [[wp:Ievan polkka|Ievan polkka]], a Finnish song generally played in the background of the meme.
